schema_assertions: 3603 source rows contain a non-null wyId that is unique across the file
the public transform copies wyId to player_id and applies one-pass literal Unicode decoding, NFC normalization, and trimming to shortName
the public corner-situation and five-question derivatives contain only player_id and display_name identity fields, with count permitted only on aggregate leader rows
all 12 fixed-example actor ledgers join without a missing player and fail closed when a required player is removed
the five sequence signatures combine recorded situation category with first-follow-up team role and do not establish a designed routine, strength, weakness, or recommendation
playerId identifies the actor associated with a recorded event and does not establish physical contact, reception, duel victory, marking, reach, or tactical effect
